sourceFile: 02. BRS-161016 GMI Report  test MTR Suspension D used Susp- Array 161014 D-1 changing tin lating method - 2025.05.13_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid source rows but misgroups the main case and contains incorrect module comparisons.
issues: Review title/purpose are taken from Decap 931, not the main plating-method test report.
Changed factor is noisy and includes TOTAL; it should be normal line vs suspension D changed tin plating method.
TEST MODULE S936 and total results are compared to the S931 normal row, causing wrong deltas and judgement.
Decap reason tables are treated as measurements and cited mostly by headers, not data rows.
Evidence mixes context, headers, and outcomes without preserving model subgroup keys.
correctionPlan: Retitle the case from TEST SPK/TEST MODULE and set purpose to the tin plating method validation.
Define one changed factor: normal line vs test suspension D with changed tin plating method; keep model as subgroup.
Recompute module outcomes using S931 rows 16/18, S936 rows 20/22, and total rows 24/26.
Convert decap sheets to root-cause context/outcomes or remove them from changed-factor measurements.
Use concise evidence rows for title, content, comparison rows, and decisions only.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient until mispaired comparisons and header-only decap citations are corrected.
